momo:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: production sprite pose sheet for a mobile monster selector.
Primary request: Produce ONE original character sprite sheet, landscape 2048x1024 pixels, EXACTLY four equal columns and two equal rows, eight equal 512x512 cells. Real transparent alpha background, with no fake checkerboard, no visible grid, no labels, no text, no ground, no ground shadows and no props.
Style: Simple bold flat 2D cartoon shapes, saturated colors, charming slightly silly monster, minimal shading, clean smooth silhouette. Flat graphic art suitable for a joyful children's music app. Not 3D, not realistic, no lighting effects.
Composition: EXACT 4x2 arrangement. SAME character in all eight frames; consistent anatomy, body scale, design, colors and proportions across every cell. Full body centered within each cell. Normally feet meet local y=450px baseline. Maintain at least 50px transparent margins within each cell; no limbs cross boundaries. Each pose fits entirely in its own cell. Do not enlarge any frame. All eight figures are the same size.
Eight poses in reading order, row-major:
0 top left: neutral smiling, eyes open, arms down.
1 top second: identical to pose 0 except eyes fully closed for blinking.
2 top third: leaning gently left with arms in a dancing pose.
3 top right: leaning gently right with the opposite dancing pose.
4 bottom left: waving one hand.
5 bottom second: both arms raised, smiling excitedly.
6 bottom third: feet tucked in during a small happy jump.
7 bottom right: laughing with crescent eyes and hands near cheeks.
No copyrighted characters or recognizable existing mascots.
Character name (never render name): Momo. Friendly round BLUE shaggy monster: electric cobalt shaggy hair around top and sides, sky-blue pear-shaped face/body, two large white oval eyes with dark indigo pupils, small mouth with two tiny white teeth, small sky-blue arms and feet, a tiny yellow tuft or spot on chest that is NOT a tie. Adorable bashful personality. Rounded, soft, funny and lovable.
